title: Alljoined1
description: Alljoined1 is an EEG dataset capturing neural responses of eight healthy adults to rapid serial visual presentation of natural images drawn from the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD), designed for EEG-to-image decoding research. Recordings were made with a 64-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system at 512 Hz, using an oddball detection paradigm across one or two sessions per participant. The dataset includes raw BDF EEG files, event annotations linking to stimulus images, and derivative epoched data preprocessed by the original authors.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a 64-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system with 24-bit A/D conversion at 512 Hz, referenced to CMS/DRL with average reference applied in preprocessing. Participants viewed images in an RSVP paradigm (300 ms image, 300 ms blank, plus jitter) performing an oddball detection task. Preprocessing by the original authors included 0.5-125 Hz band-pass filtering, 60 Hz notch filtering, FastICA for artifact removal, epoch extraction (-50 to 600 ms), AutoReject-based artifact rejection, baseline correction, and average re-referencing.
